title: macOS: workspace tests compare os.tmpdir() (/var/folders) with realpath'd git paths (/private/var/folders)
observation: On macOS, tests in workspace-ledger (2), workspace-prune and workspaces build fixtures under os.tmpdir() (/var/folders/...) and compare against paths read back from git, which are realpath'd (/private/var/folders/...). They fail identically on plain origin/main afe7870b in a fresh worktree and in the main checkout, so `npm test` is permanently red on a maintainer Mac and hides new failures. Not caused by any open PR. Tracked as GitHub issue #377.
evidence: 2026-09-20 pre-merge audit: full `npm test` on origin/main afe7870b + 8 PRs = 2511 tests / 2492 pass / 7 fail / 12 skip; the same 7 fail on plain origin/main (fresh worktree AND main checkout)
